# Elite Knight Co., Ltd.

> Elite Knight Co., Ltd. (บริษัท เอลีท ไนท์ จำกัด) is an enterprise consulting firm in Bangkok, Thailand. We help organizations turn strategy, data, AI, cybersecurity, governance, and delivery into measurable business outcomes.

Elite Knight serves enterprise executives, technology leaders, risk leaders, and transformation teams in Thailand. Core capabilities include Data & AI consulting, Data Governance, AI Governance, Cybersecurity and Digital Trust, Digital Transformation, Management Consulting, and Strategic PMO. Relevant frameworks include ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST, COBIT, ITIL, and DAMA-DMBOK.

Contact: Mobile +66 63 664 1555; email [info@ek.co.th](mailto:info@ek.co.th).

## Consulting services

- [Data & AI Consulting](https://www.ek.co.th/data-ai-consulting.html): Data strategy, analytics, Generative AI, Data Governance, and AI Governance.
- [Cybersecurity Consulting](https://www.ek.co.th/cybersecurity-consulting.html): Cybersecurity, Digital Trust, cyber risk, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST, PDPA, and cyber resilience.
- [Digital Transformation Consulting](https://www.ek.co.th/digital-transformation-consulting.html): Digital strategy, process improvement, automation, change management, and delivery.
- [Management Consulting](https://www.ek.co.th/management-consulting.html): Corporate strategy, operating model, organization design, and performance management.
- [Strategic PMO Consulting](https://www.ek.co.th/strategic-pmo-consulting.html): Portfolio management, program governance, project health checks, and benefits realization.
